description:
The PostJoy G26 Electric Mountain Bike is built for riders who want dependable electric power, longer range, and lightweight handling. With a 1500W peak motor, 48V 10Ah battery, front suspension fork, and up to 35 miles of range, the G26 is a versatile eBike for commuting, cruising, and light trail riding.

The PostJoy G26 gives riders a balanced combination of power, range, comfort, and everyday practicality. It is designed for those who want an electric mountain bike that feels natural, rides efficiently, and handles both city routes and light outdoor paths with ease.
Its 1500W peak motor provides smooth acceleration and dependable support, while the 48V 10Ah battery delivers up to 35 miles of max range. That extra range makes the G26 a smart choice for riders who want more distance without moving into a heavier fat tire platform.
The 26" x 1.95" tires offer efficient rolling and familiar control, while the front suspension fork helps absorb bumps from uneven roads and trails. With precision disc brakes, 7-speed transmission, IPX5 water resistance, and a lightweight 49.6 lbs build, the G26 is ready for everyday riders who want more freedom in every trip.
